calibration_evidence.pherc172_ordering_note: The historical benchmark read unpadded 0.tif..32.tif lexicographically, so its recorded middle and last hashes were physical slices 24.tif and 9.tif. Numeric physical ordering is now mandatory. PHerc172 remains a coverage diagnostic because all 18 patches pass the new coverage checks, but it is not source-locked full-positive evidence for the inherited depth gate.

selection_note: Coverage thresholds are post-hoc for the first PHerc211 retained batch and descriptive controls. PHerc0139 supplies 15 source-locked full-positive candidates. PHerc172 supplies coverage-only diagnostics after discovery of a historical lexicographic slice-order bug. The thresholds are frozen before use on later surfaces and must not be described as independent validation.
